summary: This note is an excerpt from a Wikipedia list of Pirates of the Caribbean characters, with entries for Carina Smyth and Captain Edward Teague. Carina Smyth, played by Kaya Scodelario in Dead Men Tell No Tales, was left at an orphanage as a child and uses her father's diary to search for the Trident of Poseidon, with an interest in astronomy and sciences. Captain Edward Teague, played by Keith Richards, is Jack's father, a former pirate lord of Madagascar who now keeps the Pirate Code and appears in three films.

key_facts: Carina Smyth is portrayed by Kaya Scodelario in Dead Men Tell No Tales.
Carina Smyth was left at an orphanage as a child.
Carina Smyth uses the diary her father left her to search for the Trident of Poseidon.
Carina Smyth is interested in the sciences, particularly astronomy.
Captain Edward Teague is played by Keith Richards.
Captain Edward Teague is Jack's father.
Captain Edward Teague is the former pirate lord of Madagascar.
Captain Edward Teague is now the keeper of the Pirate Code.
Captain Edward Teague appears in At World's End, On Stranger Tides and Dead Men Tell No Tales.
